note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a Const 20, ARG 2(1), 6, Decree 3213/84 3-8; A06b Const 20, ARG 2(1), 6, Decree 3213/84 3-8; L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 2 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.
